contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with the packet CE conventions and with corroborated FND-0125, FND-0135, FND-0139, and FND-0142. Independent primary checks. (1) Clifford (Hartshorne IV.5.4): an effective special divisor D of degree 4 satisfies h^0(O(D))<=3, with equality only if C is hyperelliptic and D is linearly equivalent to twice a hyperelliptic divisor. A tetragonal fibre D always has h^0>=2 and is special on a genus-6 curve, so h^0(O_C(D))=2 on every non-hyperelliptic fibre. (2) Canning-Larson arXiv:2104.05820v2 (4.5) and Section 4.3: e1=1 if and only if C is hyperelliptic, in which case the degree-4 map factors as q o h; the unique allowed type at g=6 is E=(1,4,4), F=(2,7), the stratum Z. The F=(4,5) strata are only Psi0 E=(3,3,3) and Psi1 E=(2,3,4). Lemma 4.5 identifies beta^{-1}(M^3_6)=Z union Psi2, so no balanced F=(4,5) fibre is hyperelliptic-composed. SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 records the same F=O(f1)+O(f2) convention with deg F=g+3, hence balanced type O(4)+O(5) at g=6, and Lemma 10.10 identifies the f1>=4 open as the complement of M^3_6 and the plane-quintic locus. (3) Uniqueness of F=(2,7) on the hyperelliptic-composed locus follows from the CE inequalities (4.3)-(4.9) of 2104.05820v2 together with Vakil-Vemulapalli arXiv:2410.22531v4 Section 3.14: smoothness of an imprimitive quartic cover with e1=1 forces f1=2e1. (4) On the ordered balanced failure model, O(Gamma) isomorphic to L isomorphic to omega(-D) gives omega(-Gamma) isomorphic to O(D), so geometric-fibre rank of p_* omega_{C/T}(-Gamma) equals h^0(O(D))=2. This is a geometric-fibre statement; FND-0131 still forbids promoting it to a locally free sheaf over an arbitrary nonreduced base without a separate constant-rank argument. The three clauses of FND-0145 are therefore true on geometric fibres of a balanced genus-6 degree-4 CE family and are strictly coarser than FND-0142, which already records h^0(O_C(D))=2, h^0(L)=3, h^1(L)=2 under (CE)+(BAL)+(N) and the precise warning that only hyperelliptic-composed pencils, not all non-primitive pencils, need be excluded. Distinct new content: none. Merge into FND-0142 rather than promoting a duplicate lemma.
